svg.title: A particular solution lives on one interval
svg.desc: The slope field of dy/dx = y² with the curve y = 1/(1 − x). The crimson branch through the closed point (0, 1) rises without bound as x approaches the dashed vertical asymptote x = 1; it is the solution, with domain x < 1. The grey dashed branch for x > 1, below the x-axis, also fits the equation but is not connected to (0, 1), so it is not part of this solution.
